nodes.title: H3 Reference to Video (pass 1 at 0.3 MP)
About this workflow
widgets_values:
Swap - Character Replace: whole-video character replacement with MiniMax H3, through the SeamStitch Swap nodes. See the SeamStitch README, section "SeamStitch Swap".

Set first: on the Planner's strip, load your video (a new job is named after it); in group 1, your character sheet.

Swap · Plan: SeamStitch Swap Planner. The strip: the source with its cuts, splits and chunks, the mask row and the prompt row. Its buttons set the run and queue it: detect + plan, draft prompts, mark, render pending, a chunk's render / re-roll, assemble. Pins come from the neighbours' takes at execution.

Swap Render · Character Replace: H3 Ref2VA pass 1 at 0.3 MP, then the 1 MP refine, a resize to the source size and a light sharpen (Sharpen Image, alpha 0.2). Its inputs come from the Planner: images / audio (on H3's 24 fps clock) / prompt / length / seed / width / height, the pins in both passes (SeamStitch MiniMax Guides, clip), and the chunk's mark option (Swap Option, default on: SAM3 paints the source person before H3 sees the guide). Who SAM3 looks for in the source is the strip's "replace" field (Swap Option target, default "person"; the output score keeps "person"); its invert option paints everything else instead.

Swap Score (SAM3): the output's person mask, for the Take's scores.
Swap · Take: saves the take (FFV1 + FLAC, source fps, original audio), its lineage, masks, scores and review clip.
Swap · Assemble: runs on an assemble run only.
Swap Mark (SAM3): a mark run tracks and caches the source person up front.
Swap · Draft: drafts the subject (from the sheet) and each chunk's prompt (QwenVL; Omni + faster-whisper for the dialogue).

The strip frees ComfyUI's memory before each render and draft it queues: render lengths over 209 frames failed at the refine on 64 GB of system RAM.
